name: 小雪初晴II
group_note: 小雪初晴II (SnowMud), a Wen Ruian-novel-themed MUD, sibling of 117 xxcq (branded '大侠传奇之小雪初晴'). WASM pass fixed 2 distinct §7.52-class socket-daemon bugs: (1) adm/daemons/httpd.lpc, a self-contained web server (JackyBoy@CuteRabbits Studio port), no external callers -- gutted every socket-touching function AND, per updated practice, disabled the entry point entirely: create() no longer schedules call_out("setup", 5) and no longer announces a false '网页服务器启动成功' success message. (2) adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc, a genuinely multi-purpose intermud daemon (query_mud_name()/muds mapping/query_udp_port() etc are called from ~28 other service files: mudlist_a/mudlist_q/gtell/gchannel/rwho/ping/etc) -- per AGENTS.md §7.52's explicit exception for multi-purpose daemons, did NOT disable the whole file; only gutted the two socket-touching entry points (startup_udp() now just returns 0, matching its own existing failure-return convention so create()'s 'if (startup_udp()) init_database();' naturally skips the socket-dependent database init without any other code change; send_udp() now a no-op) plus removed one straggling socket_close() call in send_shutdown(). Unlike xxcq, this snapshot's SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd (not the securd.lpc bootstrap-account pattern) and genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot; adm/etc/ already exists with real data (no missing-directory bug here, unlike its xxcq sibling). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (14 existing accounts across (admin)/(hufa)/(immortal)/(apprentice) tiers). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 select -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> temporary password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> gender (m/f) -> email-registration gate at the wizard-guild starting room (register/zhuce command, or type the literal Chinese phrase to proceed) -> enters world with a full character sheet, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)' with fluffos appearing in an active-quest listing alongside the other admins. LPC formatter run across all 3034 .lpc files (2976 written, 28 errors, 30 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. The one map.lpc file present confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to its pre-format blob. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
